## Research Domains (named clusters within the AUGMANITAI Compendium)

AUGMANITAI · NEOMANITAI (Knowledge Graph layer) · PERMANITAI (Substrate-Independent Performance Factor framework) · ROBMANITAI (Robotics Human-AI Interaction Phenomenology, extending to multi-robot coordination, human-robot team dynamics, and multi-agent / agent-team orchestration) · CHRONOMANITAI · CLIMMANITAI · JURMANITAI · ETHMANITAI · BIOMANITAI · DSAMANITAI · FINMANITAI · SECMANITAI · NEUMANITAI · QUAMANITAI · LONMANITAI · MEDMANITAI · MIGMANITAI · SPAMANITAI · MILMANITAI · THEOMANITAI · CYBMANITAI · HYBMANITAI · EDUMANITAI

## Methodological Frame

Holistic Performance Analysis Methodology (Observable / Decomposable / Measurable / Controllable) — a cross-domain transfer of high-performance sport-science methodology (25-year Bundesliga tennis coaching lineage) to human-AI interaction analysis and multi-agent / robot-team performance.

Multi-LLM Triadic Audit Framework · Cross-LLM Convergence Methodology · N=1 Extreme Observation Methodology · Compression Axiom · Living-Document Discipline · ISO 704/1087/30042 aligned Terminology Engineering.

## What is publicly indexable

Per-term HTML pages at /atlas/{slug}/ contain inline JSON-LD (Schema.org DefinedTerm + skos:Concept + prov:Entity). All terms discoverable via sitemap.xml. Lightweight metadata descriptors at /exports/.

## What is NOT publicly distributed at this stage

Bulk machine-readable exports (RDF/Turtle bulk, JSON-LD bulk, OWL ontology bulk, CSV, JSONL, embeddings, full relations graph, QA-pairs, prompt library, ROS2 messages, operational methodology details).

These are stored in a restricted Zenodo deposit (Concept-DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20118267, files locked, metadata public).

## Researcher access

Researchers seeking access to bulk deep-layer for legitimate scholarly purposes contact via ORCID-linked channels: https://orcid.org/0009-0006-3773-7796 or augmanitai@gmail.com. Subject to brief research-purpose statement and attribution agreement.
